To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the bending moment distribution of a TF coil is affected by the stiffness of the coil case, the intercoil structure, and the central support.

the bending moments in the windings of the “bending free" TF coils are not as small as it was thought before, and that the TF coils with the “bending-free” shape are more sensitive to the coil case design.

1) the bending free shape is not as bending free as it is believed, 2) a coil case can introduce additional bending to the coil, and 3) the bending free shapes impose additional constraints on the overall system design.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the optimization of the structural performance of a tokamak magnet system.
the optimization of structural performance of the toroidal field coil system of a tokamak.
the optimization of the TF coil shape and the magnet system design for a tokamak.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
a “bending-free” design should be used for a TF coil only if the coil case is not reinforced.
the “bending free shapes” are not the best choice for TF coils and that a careful consideration of the coil case and other structural components is needed for the design of a TF coil system.
a constant tension shape is not the optimal solution for TF coils and a compromise between structural and electromagnetic requirements is needed.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the “bending free shapes” of TF coils are not as “bending free as it may seem” and the design of TF coils should be based on a more rigorous analysis.
the “bending free shape” concept is valid for the TF coil system design only when the TF coil case is not considered.
, while the bending free shape can reduce the bending moment in the TF coil, it does not eliminate it.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the bending in the wind pack is a function of the coil shape, the coil case stiffness and the support system stiffness.
the structural performance of a TF coil system should be assessed using an accurate FEA model of the magnet system.
the TF coils are very complex structures and the shape optimization should take into consideration the stiffness of all structural components of the magnet system.
